question: How much reservation has the Haryana government announced for Agniveers in employment in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**20%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Haryana government** has announced a **20% reservation** for **Agniveers** in state government jobs starting from **April 2025**.
 
• This decision is part of the state’s initiative to encourage youth participation in the **Agnipath Scheme**, launched by the central government.
 
• The reservation applies to both **Group C** and **Group D government jobs**, ensuring that Agniveers have access to stable employment opportunities after their service in the armed forces.
 
• The Agnipath Scheme allows youth to serve in the Indian Armed Forces for a short period (4 years). Haryana’s reservation policy is designed to ensure these individuals can transition smoothly to civilian life post-service.</li&
